payload.note: [llm audit] This is a static 0 K equation-of-state fit, so no MD is involved and an 8-atom cell with no k-points is appropriate. Diamond-cubic Si has no free internal coordinates, so a rigid E(V) scan is exact. MACE-MP-0 was trained on inorganic crystals like Si and is used within its domain. Convergence was checked across EOS forms, fitting range (±6% gives 5.4655 Å) and a 64-atom supercell, and the PBE-level offset is correctly reported as a systematic uncertainty. The only slip is a wording one: the note calls the error 'overbinding' when PBE actually underbinds, which overestimates a0. This does not affect the number. [claude-opus-5-5, $0.0168]
